context.question: Who will win the 2012 US presidential election?
context.setting: Incumbent President Barack Obama is running for re-election; Mitt Romney is the presumptive Republican nominee. Polling shows a competitive race. The general election is on 6 November 2012, the day a Mercury retrograde period begins.

provenance.work: Astrology News Service, 'Panel of Astrologers Predicts Obama Victory', May 2012 (New Orleans)
